nature.kind: code | documentation | design | data | mixed | <one word of your own>

programming_languages: the languages of the code, as names, or an empty list

status_vocabulary.mapped: triage | backlog | ready | in-progress | in-review | done | cancelled | null

notes: anything the later passes should know
